prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 10 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, Night, warm interior downlights turning soft and glowing.
Image 1: the character sheet of 路少泽 (28), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of 纪然 (27), look S3
Image 3: the character sheet of 林青羽 (21), look S2
Image 4: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 5: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 7: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 8: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 9: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 10: the prop black handbag; use only structure, material, and color
Image 11: the prop grocery bag full of greens; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Lu Shaoze stands at the elevator end of the autumn landscape painting, leaning close toward Ji Ran with a triumphant sneer. Ji Ran stands at the front-door end of the painting, her jaw clenched, the black handbag on her arm. The walnut front door is closed behind her. The camera stays in front of the painting wall.
Panel 1: Medium shot, low angle on Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze straightens up, tugs his navy lapels and taps his own chest proudly.
Panel 2: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level on Ji Ran. Ji Ran gives him a cold, disgusted look.
Panel 3: Medium close-up, over-the-shoulder shot past Ji Ran onto Lu Shaoze, eye-level. Lu Shaoze steps nearer and looks down at her with a possessive smile.
Panel 4: Close-up, quick push in on Lu Shaoze, eye-level. Lu Shaoze raises an eyebrow and smirks.
Panel 5: Medium shot, eye-level two-shot beneath the painting. Lu Shaoze reaches his hand toward Ji Ran's shoulder, and she stiffens.
Panel 6: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, facing the painting wall, with the elevator doors at frame left and the closed walnut front door at frame right. The elevator doors behind Lu Shaoze slide open in cool light, and Lin Qingyu steps out in his white hoodie, carrying the grocery bag full of greens in one hand. The walnut front door stays closed.
Panel 7: Medium shot, low angle, handheld, following Lin Qingyu from the elevator past Lu Shaoze to Ji Ran's side. Lin Qingyu walks past Lu Shaoze, slides his free arm around Ji Ran's waist, draws her against his side and faces Lu Shaoze, the grocery bag in his other hand, so that Lu Shaoze's reaching hand stops in midair.
Panel 8: Medium close-up, eye-level on Lin Qingyu and Ji Ran. Lin Qingyu tilts his head toward Ji Ran with a sweet, boyish smile, the grocery bag of greens at his side, his eyes flicking at Lu Shaoze, while Ji Ran glances up at him in surprise.
Panel 9: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level on Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze's hand hangs frozen in midair, his jaw drops and his face reddens.
Panel 10: Wide shot, high angle, slow pull out from the three of them beneath the painting. Lin Qingyu holds Ji Ran at the front-door end of the painting, the grocery bag in his other hand and the walnut front door closed behind them, while Lu Shaoze stands stunned at the elevator end. Soft glowing light and drifting snow-like flakes fill the image.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
